notes.content:
Fixed an issue on Steam Deck where a phantom resolution option would appear in the config.
 Minor text fixes.

notes.title: Technical Update to Reduce File Size
notes.content: Moved the Audio Novel files to each separate Audio Novel DLC Steam depot so that they aren't unnecessarily downloaded by players who don't own the Audio Novel episodes.

notes.title: SeaBed Audio Novel Collection Now Complete!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27773285/3ad45c34b6841884660a53fd462a64f9552046bf.jpg
Thank you for the wait! We're happy to announce that the SeaBed Audio Novel Collection is now complete with the release of Episode 3 "Silvergrass Station Cleaning"!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184982/SeaBed_Audio_Novel_Collection__Episode_3__Silvergrass_Station_Cleaning/

An unexpected visitor. A car ride. A quiet station.

Starring
    Mizuno Sachiko (Narrator & High Schooler): Kondo Yui
    Takako: Matsui Eriko
    Izuhana Midori: Aiya Saki
    Weather Report, Coffee Shop Owner: Tokiwa Shouhei

We hope you have been enjoying the journey with the teenage goofball Takako and her handler, Sachiko!

Finally, an original short story "Night Flight" by Paleontology is now available as a free Extra Episode to owners of the SeaBed Audio Novel Collection!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184983/SeaBed_Audio_Novel_Collection__Extra_Episode__Night_Flight

The beginning of a journey. Private tutoring. Arrival.

Starring
    Kotani Fujika: Shioiri Asuka
    Sakura Aoi: Kita Natsuki 
    Coffee Shop Waitress: Maruyama Miki

All 4 episodes in the Audio Novel Collection have been written and directed by Paleontology, and beautifully illustrated by Tonbu.

Thank you for joining us on this journey and showing so much love for the game that it allowed us to produce these new scenarios together with Paleontology.

notes.title: SeaBed Audio Novel Collection Episode 1 Now Available!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27773285/50e14bf77e292f953df9380827a76ecb51f99679.jpg

Thank you all SeaBed fans for your continued support over the years! It's made it possible for us to create something new again! We're now happy to announce a project where we were able to give voice to the game's beloved characters in an all-new story...

SeaBed Audio Novel Collection Episode 1 - "Brick Incinerator" is here!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184980/SeaBed_Audio_Novel_Collection__Episode_1__Brick_Incinerator/
This Audio Novel Collection is a series of newly written audio novels for the beloved yuri-themed mystery visual novel.

Episode 1 contains:
Meeting at the school. A strange incident. A scary story. (Length: 13:15)

The episodes are delivered in both a subtitled video format, and a Japanese audio-only track in .wav format.

The video supports Japanese, Japanese (closed captions), English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Korean subtitles which can be switched at will.

The new Audio Novel scenarios are written by hide38 and directed by AKIRA, with beautiful key illustrations by Tonbu.

Starring
Sachiko has been given a cool and subtle voice by Kondo Yui, known as Biwa Hayahide in Uma Musume, Kiba Mikoto in Triage X, and Nath in 100% Orange Juice!

Meanwhile Takako's silly antics are brought to life by Matsui Eriko (Fuji Kiseki in Uma Musume, Maki Kyouko in Houkago Saikoro Club, Kokuyou in Tsugu Tsugumomo, Kamiya Nao in The iDOLM@STER Cinderella Girls)!

English Translation: Andrew Hodgson
Chinese Translation: Windyshine
Korean Translation: Moonbi
    
The other 2 episodes + Extra episode of the collection will be released one by one over the coming months! 

We hope you can all enter into a wonderful year 2023 with this release!
